reply:
Subject: Clarification Required for Order Processing

Dear Tom,

Thank you for your recent message. I appreciate your request regarding the order of 5,000 units.

However, to proceed efficiently, could you kindly confirm your company and country location? This information will help us ensure compliance and facilitate a smooth shipping process.

I look forward to your prompt response.
Best Regards.
Xian Diao
DIOX Ltd.
